messages:
sam: Quick sync on the model catalog compare UX. Pitched changes: persist active filters across compare sessions, clarify which sort is applied, and keyboard-first row selection. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE
sam: Also need to decide how we surface "stale" perf badges (when last-eval > 30d).
jen: Love the keyboard-first angle. For compare, we should allow arrow keys to move focus between rows and spacebar to toggle selection. Visual focus state must be high-contrast.
jen: On filter persistence: users expect filters to carry into the compare modal, but I'm wary of silently mutating their active catalog view. Proposal: show an inline note inside compare: "Applied catalog filters: X, Y — clear?" with a clear CTA.
tom: FE note: keyboard selection OK. We'll need to ensure focus management when the compare panel opens. Use roving tabindex pattern and set aria-pressed on selected rows.

rhea: Accessibility checklist:
- roving tabindex for row list
- aria-pressed for selection buttons
- announce to SRs when compare selection changes (aria-live=polite)
- visible focus outline 3px, not just color
- ensure badge icons have accessible names (not color-only)

marco: Regarding "stale" badges: our infra emits last_eval_ts and env. Suggested policy: "stale" if last_eval_ts < now - 30d => render badge with a warning icon and tooltip: "Performance data 35 days old. Re-evaluate for current numbers."
marco: Also propose adding a filter facet "has recent metrics" so users can hide entries without fresh evals. That will help discovery.
sophie: From research: users get confused when compare order jumps after toggling filters. We should persist the selected sort (e.g., P50 asc) in the compare panel unless user explicitly changes it. Small microcopy helps: "Sorted by P50 latency (asc)".
jen: Good call. Also UX nit: when a pinned version is included in a compare, highlight it with a faint pin background instead of a separate badge to reduce badge noise.
tom: Implementation constraints: pin highlight is cheap. But combined with reliability+perf+stale badges the row might look busy. We must prioritize visual hierarchy and possibly collapse less-critical badges behind a "..." overflow with tooltip.
rhea: A11y for overflow menu: keyboard reachable, labeled as "more metrics" and each metric option must be a focusable button.
marco: For sorting clarity: include a small persistent chip near the top of compare: "Sorting: P50 (asc)" which is clickable to open sort options. That avoids hidden state.
sam: Decision candidates (need quick thumbs):
1) Persist filters into compare but show inline note and allow quick clear.
2) Keep sort persistent across compare sessions and show chip label.
3) Keyboard first row selection + roving tabindex + aria-live announcements.
4) Stale badge if >30d + "has recent metrics" filter.
5) Pin highlight in-row, overflow for low-priority badges.

jen: 👍 for all 5.
tom: +1, will add tasks.
rhea: +1 but please ensure aria-live doesn't spam users; debounce announcements.
marco: +1, will add backend flag for has_recent_metrics and compute last_eval_ts.
sophie: +1 from research. Also recommend we record a small event when users clear filters inside compare to measure confusion.
infra-bot: Deploy preview scheduled: 2024-05-03 22:00 UTC. Preview link will be posted to this thread after CI passes.
sam: Great. I'll capture acceptance criteria and break into tickets. Owners: jen (design), tom (frontend), marco (data), rhea (a11y), sophie (telemetry). Target: staging preview next week.
